headline: NASA’s Artemis II mission aims to send humans back to the Moon for the first time since 1972, but some researchers remain underwhelmed. The mission’s main goals are to test aspects of human space flight ahead of future, more complex missions. However, the scientific community has mixed opinions about the mission, with some expressing excitement and others criticizing the lack of enthusiasm and the political context surrounding the mission.

The NBA is investigating the LA Clippers for allegedly circumventing the salary cap to pay star Kawhi Leonard. The investigation, led by the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz, began in September 2025 and centers on allegations that Clippers owner Steve Ballmer and the team orchestrated a $28 million endorsement deal between Leonard and Aspiration, a now-bankrupt green banking company in which Ballmer had invested.
Nearly 20 million returns have already claimed President Donald Trump's "no tax on overtime" deduction. Here's what the popularity means for the tax break.
Turkish and German foreign ministers have discussed efforts to end the war in the Middle East. The meeting aimed to find a resolution to the ongoing conflict.

Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill has demonstrated significantly greater mean weight loss than Eli Lilly's rival pill Foundayo in a cross-trial comparison. The study found that 84% of patients favored a drug profile similar to that of Wegovy.
US futures have dropped following a speech by Trump that has dashed hopes for an early end to the war. The speech has led to uncertainty in the markets.
Wimbledon champion Iga Swiatek will work with Francisco Roig - former coach of Rafael Nadal and Emma Raducanu - as she looks to improve her form.

The NBA's regular season has more than a week remaining, but many team executives' focus has already shifted to May 10, the day the league will conduct its annual lottery to determine the draft order for what has a chance to be a special 2026 class. With the men's Final Four happening this weekend, what are league insiders saying about BYU wing AJ Dybantsa, Kansas guard Darryn Peterson, Duke forward Cameron Boozer and other top prospects?

Arizona Wildcats are one win away from their first Final Four in 25 years, and they're staying focused on the present moment. The team has been able to stay in the present and not get caught up in the history of the program, which has been a key factor in their success.

France's Lightning Stock Exchange is preparing to host what could become Europe’s first fully onchain stock market debut. The move positions Lise and ST Group as an early test case for going public directly on blockchain rails within EU rules.
The Czech government is considering tax cuts and profit caps to curb fuel prices. This move is aimed at reducing the financial burden on citizens due to rising fuel costs.

UK drivers are being urged to look for the cheapest petrol and “to fill up as usual” as travellers prepare to make 21.7m journeys on what is expected to be the busiest Easter on the roads in four years. The average price of a litre of unleaded petrol rose by 20p in March to 152.83p.

Israel's record budget of $271bn will finance expanding illegal settlements in the occupied West Bank, with a massive financial injection into extreme right-wing projects. The budget allocation comes against a backdrop of surging violence by Israeli settlers towards Palestinians.

Policy gradient methods have enjoyed great success in deep reinforcement learning but suffer from high variance of gradient estimates. The high variance problem is particularly exasperated in problems with long horizons or high-dimensional action spaces.

This article proposes a practical method for L₀ norm regularization for neural networks, which can greatly speed up training and inference, and improve generalization. The method uses a collection of non-negative stochastic gates to determine which weights to set to zero.

This paper studies statistical/computational tradeoffs in learning robust classifiers. It extends previous work in three directions, demonstrating classification tasks where computationally efficient robust classification is impossible and showing hard-to-robustly-learn classification tasks in the large-perturbation regime.

Researchers show that a GPT-3 model can learn to express uncertainty about its own answers in natural language. The model generates both an answer and a level of confidence, which maps to probabilities that are well calibrated.

Advanced AI models pose significant risks to public safety, and proactive management is necessary to mitigate these risks. The regulation of frontier AI models requires standard-setting processes, registration and reporting requirements, and mechanisms to ensure compliance with safety standards.

10BedICU uses OpenAI’s API to improve India’s critical care infrastructure. The organization aims to elevate India’s critical care infrastructure, widening access to quality healthcare to India’s most underserved communities.
Cushion is an open-source AI note-taking app that integrates a local-first markdown workspace with AI chat. It allows users to write, organize, and think in one place.

Deep reinforcement learning has achieved many impressive results in recent years, but tasks with sparse rewards or long horizons continue to pose significant challenges. This paper proposes a general framework that first learns useful skills in a pre-training environment, and then leverages the acquired skills for learning faster in downstream tasks.

This work shows that contrastive pre-training on unsupervised data at scale leads to high-quality vector representations of text and code. The same unsupervised text embeddings achieve new state-of-the-art results in linear-probe classification and display impressive semantic search capabilities.

This article discusses the problem of exploration in meta reinforcement learning and presents two new algorithms: E-MAML and E-RL². The results show that these algorithms deliver better performance on tasks where exploration is important.

This article discusses how an ensemble of Q*-functions can be used for more effective exploration in deep reinforcement learning. The proposed exploration strategy is based on upper-confidence bounds (UCB) and has shown significant gains on the Atari benchmark.

This research demonstrates a generally applicable approach to providing strong privacy guarantees for training data, called Private Aggregation of Teacher Ensembles (PATE). The approach combines multiple models trained with disjoint datasets to learn a student model that cannot directly access individual teacher or underlying data. The student's privacy properties can be understood both intuitively and formally, in terms of differential privacy.
A Tamagotchi for your desktop, terminal, and AI agents. Care for your pet via desktop, terminal, or MCP.
A female suspect has been detained in connection with an explosion that killed a prominent Russian military blogger at a cafe in St. Petersburg on Sunday.
Create Mappins is a tool for creating custom map pins and embedding them anywhere. It allows users to paste addresses, customize pins, and share them via link or embed code.

One-shot imitation learning is a meta-learning framework that enables robots to learn from few demonstrations and generalize to new situations. The framework uses a neural net that takes a demonstration and the current state as input and outputs an action to match the second demonstration.

Developing control policies in simulation is often more practical and safer than directly running experiments in the real world. This paper investigates settings where the sequence of states traversed in simulation remains reasonable for the real world, even if the details of the controls are not.

Point-E is a system that generates 3D point clouds from complex prompts, producing 3D models in only 1-2 minutes on a single GPU. The system uses a text-to-image diffusion model and a second diffusion model to condition on the generated image.

This paper explores the use of large language models to improve the effectiveness of mutation operators in genetic programming, with implications for open-endedness, deep learning, and reinforcement learning. The model can generate hundreds of thousands of functional examples of Python programs that output working ambulating robots.
OpenYak is an open-source desktop AI agent that handles your files, documents, and workflows locally. It supports 100+ cloud models and 20+ built-in tools, and is free to start.
Slapppy is a native macOS menu bar app that turns your trackpad or mouse into a shortcut engine. It allows users to trigger macros with rhythmic taps on their trackpad or mouse.

The Variational Lossy Autoencoder is a method for learning global representations by combining Variational Autoencoder (VAE) with neural autoregressive models. This approach allows for control over what the global latent code can learn and can force the global latent code to discard irrelevant information.

This article discusses a method called Learning with Opponent-Learning Awareness (LOLA), which enables agents to shape the anticipated learning of other agents in the environment. LOLA leads to the emergence of cooperation in the iterated prisoners' dilemma and receives higher payouts compared to a naive learner.

OpenAI Five became the first AI system to defeat the world champions at an esports game, demonstrating that self-play reinforcement learning can achieve superhuman performance on a difficult task. The game of Dota 2 presents novel challenges for AI systems such as long time horizons, imperfect information, and complex, continuous state-action spaces.

GPT-5.3 Instant delivers more accurate answers, richer and better-contextualized results when searching the web, and reduces unnecessary dead ends, caveats, and overly declarative phrasing. This update focuses on the parts of the ChatGPT experience people feel every day: tone, relevance, and conversational flow.
Former President Donald Trump has been indicted by a Manhattan grand jury, marking the first time in US history that a current or former president has faced criminal charges.
